name: Yield Calculation 6
definition: Return provided by a financial instrument.

RedemptionPrice.name: Redemption Price
RedemptionPrice.definition: Price to which the yield has been calculated.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date/time on which the calculation is based, for example, valuation on October 1 (price date) based on price of September 19 ( value date).

ValuePeriod.name: Value Period
ValuePeriod.definition: Period on which the calculation is based.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Clarifies yield irregularities associated with date, for example when it falls on a non-business day.
